notes: Searches: 8 of 8 used, cap reached. Fetches: 31 WebFetch calls. Every date with a weekday was checked with date(1) and all agreed. Known shows (Palm Beach Card Show, Duuuval, Port Saint Lucie Card Show, Front Row Orlando, the Ultimate Banger shows, UltimateCon Daytona, Treasure Cup Kissimmee, BANDAI Fest, CoolStuffCon, and the skip list) were not researched. Almost all upcoming Florida leads come from treasurehunter.show and thecardshopfinder.com, which are on the never fetch list, so they stay leads until an organizer page is found. Guessed organizer or venue domains that did not resolve: tampasportscollectorsexpo.com, anchorupcardshow.com, banquetmasters.com, cardshowbythebay.com, the850cardshow.com, delraycardsocial.com, tampabaysportscardshow.com, clearwaterbayareacardshow.com, pensacolainterstatefairgrounds.com, baycountyfairgrounds.com, thenexuscollectormarket.com, miamiairportconvention.com, palmerpromotions.com, palmbeachkennelclub.com. Also pbconventioncenter.com/events/2026-03-01 returned 404. Tampa expo: the organizer page and the fairgrounds page disagree on the kids age (10 and under versus 8 and under), so kids are recorded free with that conflict in the notes. Central Card Fest: the city page gives 90 vendors, not a table count, so 90 is recorded as tables and this is a vendor count. The status field stays scheduled for this past edition because the schema has no completed value. Trading Card Con Tampa: the year comes from the page heading The 2026 Tour, since the dates on the page carry no year. No address, hours or admission is posted, so those are omitted. The organizer lists attendees@cardsandmoretour.com as a contact for attendees, not vendors; it is noted here only. Cardcala and MIDFLORIDA Card Expo are leads because their pages print no year. PokeKon Fest Ocala (Nov 28 2026, Hilton Ocala) appeared in a search snippet with no source URL captured, so it is noted here only. No upcoming card shows were found for Sarasota, Naples, Fort Myers or Lakeland in Nov 2026 to early 2027. Melbourne, Cocoa and Gainesville had only past shows apart from the leads above. A Gem, Mineral and Jewelry Show at the Florida State Fairgrounds on Nov 7 to 8 2026 is not a card show and was skipped. Several search results were unrelated spam or other countries and were ignored.
